If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overreaction to bullish sentiment.

If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for bearish underweighting.

If sentiment is 0.00 in the last 3 days, apply a 1.0–2.0% downward bias across all horizons to reflect lack of market conviction.

For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is >0.67, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% to prevent overextension; if sentiment is <0.33, increase by 0.5–1.0% to align with bearish momentum.

If sentiment is 0.67 in the last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% upward bias only if the prior 3-day forecast was below the 30-day moving average.

If sentiment is 0.33 in the last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward bias only if the prior 3-day forecast was above the 30-day moving average.
